lines.japanese: 働き口の見つからなかった俺は帰路につく。
lines.english: Unable to find any work, I headed home.

lines.japanese: 日付が変わる前に帰るのは久しぶりだ。
lines.english: It had been a long time since I'd gone home before midnight.

lines.japanese: 住宅街の坂道をまっすぐ上ると、街灯の間隔がまばらになってきた。あたりは薄暗い。
lines.english: As I followed the road straight uphill through the residential district, the streetlights grew farther apart. The neighborhood lay in half-darkness.

lines.japanese: 俺は息を整えるため、膝に手をついた。冬の外気を吸いこんでいると、やたらに喉が渇く。
lines.english: I bent over with my hands on my knees to catch my breath. Every lungful of winter air made me desperately thirsty.

lines.japanese: ふと見つけた。ふたつ先の街灯の下、小さな体と大きなポリ袋がアンバランスな、見知った人影──
lines.english: Then I spotted her. Two streetlights ahead stood a familiar figure, a small body dwarfed by the huge plastic bag she carried—

lines.japanese: ──俺たちのお姫さま。
lines.english: —our princess.

lines.japanese: 俺は一呼吸すると、その見知った後ろ姿に向かって駆けだした。
lines.english: I took a breath and hurried after her, recognizing her even from behind.

lines.japanese: 「小鳩」
lines.english: “Kobato.”

lines.japanese: びくっ。
lines.english: She flinched.

lines.japanese: 後ろから声をかけると、やつの肩が分かりやすいほど跳ねた。ふくらんだコンビニ袋が音を立てる。
lines.english: When I called to her from behind, her shoulders gave an unmistakable jump. The bulging convenience-store bag rustled.

lines.japanese: 「こんな時間に買い物なんか行くなよ。人さらいとか出んぞ」
lines.english: “Don't go shopping this late. Somebody might kidnap you.”

lines.japanese: やつは怯えたような目で、しかしじっと俺の顔を熟視した。
lines.english: She studied my face with frightened but intent eyes.

lines.japanese: 「なに」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「あ……な、な成田、さん……？」
lines.english: “Oh... N-N-Narita...?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ナナリタじゃなくてナリタ」
lines.english: “It’s Narita, not Na-Narita.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩は喘ぐように口をぱくぱくと動かした。もしかしたらなにか喋ってるのかもしれないが、俺の耳には届かない。
lines.english: Kobato's mouth opened and closed as though she were gasping. Maybe she was saying something, but none of it reached my ears.

lines.japanese: 「あんさ、そりゃコンビニくらいフツーに行くかもしんないけどさ。遠回りでももっと明るい道えらべって。いや、俺がなんか言える立場でもないんだけど……ったく、タカシはちゃんと指導してんのか……？」
lines.english: “Look, I know going to the convenience store is a normal thing to do. But even if it means a detour, pick a brighter road. I’m hardly in a position to lecture you, but... Damn it, has Takashi even taught you to be careful?”

lines.japanese: 「え、なに。いまなんか言った？」
lines.english: “What? Did you say something?”

lines.japanese: 「つか俺、べつに叱ってるわけじゃなくてさ、なんつーか、その……え、いま俺の言ってること分かる」
lines.english: “And I'm not scolding you or anything. It's more like... Well... Wait, do you understand what I'm saying?”

lines.japanese: 目の前の小娘はこくんこくんと何度かうなずいた。
lines.english: The girl before me nodded several times.

lines.japanese: 「まあいいや。じゃあ家まで送ってくよ」
lines.english: “All right, then. I'll walk you home.”

lines.japanese: びくっ。
lines.english: She flinched.

lines.japanese: 小娘は大きく体を震わせて、見た目にも分かるくらい戦慄した。そんなか？　そんなに怖いか俺？
lines.english: The girl shuddered from head to toe, visibly terrified. Was it that bad? Was I really that frightening?

lines.japanese: 「あ、あ、あのっ」
lines.english: “U-um!”

lines.japanese: 「あん？」
lines.english: “Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「へきっ、平気です」
lines.english: “I-I'm fine.”

lines.japanese: 「なにが」
lines.english: “What's fine?”

lines.japanese: 「ご心ぱいには及びません。ひと、ひとりで帰れます」
lines.english: “There is no need to w-worry. I can go home by myself.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ひとりで帰れますじゃなくて。どうせ帰るとこ一緒なんだから、意味ない遠慮とかやめてくんない」
lines.english: “This isn't about whether you *can* go alone. We're going to the same place anyway, so can you stop with the pointless politeness?”

lines.japanese: 俺は後ろ頭をがしがしがしと掻いた。
lines.english: I scratched hard at the back of my head.

lines.japanese: 「え、あ、帰るんですか」
lines.english: “Oh... You're going home?”

lines.japanese: 「そう、今日は仕事ないから。だから一緒に帰りませんか」
lines.english: “Yes. There's no work tonight. So, would you care to walk home together?”

lines.japanese: 「はー……はいっ、それなら」
lines.english: “Oh... Yes. If we're walking together.”

lines.japanese: 送られるのはＮＧで、一緒に帰るのはアリなのか。意地らしいねえ。なんか白髪生えンの早そうだよ、こいつ。
lines.english: She wouldn’t let me escort her, but walking home together was fine. She was almost painfully earnest. At this rate, she was going to go gray young.

lines.japanese: 「おし、じゃあさっさと行こう。こんな夜道じゃ、どっから変質者が現れるか分かんねーし」
lines.english: “Good. Then let's get moving. On a dark road like this, you never know where some pervert might appear.”

lines.japanese: 「そうかもしれません」
lines.english: “That may be true.”

lines.japanese: <8>\「じゃじゃじゃジャーン！」
lines.english: “Ta-da-da-daaa!”

lines.japanese: 「ひっ」
lines.english: “Eek!”

lines.japanese: 言ってるそばから怪しすぎる男が立ちはだかった。
lines.english: And right as I said that, an incredibly shady guy blocked our path.

lines.japanese: 俺は迷わなかった。じいさんだって分かってる、俺が強さを欲したのは元来こいつを守るためだ。
lines.english: I didn't hesitate. The old man knew it too: the reason I'd sought strength in the first place was to protect her.

lines.japanese: 身を竦ませる小鳩の前に立って壁となりながら、同時に威嚇のためのジャブを──
lines.english: I stepped in front of the cowering Kobato, making a wall of my body, and loosed a warning jab—
“Oh.”

lines.japanese: ──撃つ瞬間、相手の顔が見えたもののもう止まらなかった。
lines.english: —and saw his face just as my fist flew. Too late to stop.

lines.japanese: 「ぶへっ！」
lines.english: “Bweh!”

lines.japanese: 「あ……ごめ、おまえか……」
lines.english: “Oh... Sorry. You.”

lines.japanese: 「ぷぷッ、プ、ぷプ……」
lines.english: “P-pff, pff... Puh...”

lines.japanese: 野郎はてのひらで鼻ッ面を多いながら、なぜか笑いを堪えていた。なんで殴られて喜んでるんだこいつ。やっぱ変質者か。
lines.english: The man covered his nose with one palm, yet for some reason he was fighting back laughter. Why was he pleased to be punched? Was he a pervert after all?

lines.japanese: 「うっはー！　兄貴に気合注入してもらっちったァ！　ヤスオ感激ィ～！」
lines.english: “Whoo! Big Bro just gave me a shot of fighting spirit! Yasuo is so deeply moooved!”

lines.japanese: 「ああそう……それはよかった……」
lines.english: “Oh. Good... Glad to hear it...”

lines.japanese: いいよな、じいさん……殴っちゃったけど、相手喜んでるし……。
lines.english: This was fine, right, old man? I'd hit him, but he seemed happy about it...

lines.japanese: 「隼人君やっぱカッケーわァ！　いやァ～、自分より先に女をかばうなんて、なかなかできないっしょ、しょ、しょ、しょりりりぃぃ～ん！」
lines.english: “Hayato, you are so coool! Man, throwing yourself in front of a woman like that? Not just anybody could pull it off-off-off—offalalalala!”

lines.japanese: 「え……ともだち……？」
lines.english: “Oh... A friend...?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、違うけど、まあ、顔見知りっつうか……とりあえず無害」
lines.english: “Not a friend. I know his face, I guess... Anyway, he's harmless.”

lines.japanese: まずは小鳩の肩を叩いて安心させてやった。
lines.english: First, I patted Kobato's shoulder to reassure her.

lines.japanese: 「あるぇ～？　そっちのお嬢さん、前に見た子と違わない？　違わない？　隼人君ってさァ、守備範囲めっちゃ広いんだねえ！　小さなギャルからコツコツと！　みたいなァ？　ギャハッ！」
lines.english: “Huhhh? Isn’t this a different girl from the one I saw before? Isn’t she? Hayato, you sure cast a wide net! Starting with the tiny gals and working your way up, huh? Gah ha!”

lines.japanese: 脅威でないと知らせたにも関わらず、小鳩はさらに後ずさっていた。
lines.english: Despite my assurance that he posed no threat, Kobato had backed away even farther.

lines.japanese: 「ちょーちょー、こいつ馬鹿だから言ってることあんま真に受けないで」
lines.english: “Hey, hey. This guy’s an idiot, so don’t take anything he says too seriously.”

lines.japanese: 「はじめましてェ～！　アイアム佐久間的存在でーっす！　そちらのお嬢さんは隼人君の新しいプリティフェイス？　なんちゅー俺もプリティフェイス？　なんつってプリィ～ン！」
lines.english: “Pleased to meet yooou! I am an entity of a broadly Sakuma-like nature! Is the young lady Hayato’s new pretty face? Which makes me a pretty face too? Preeetty pudding!”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ。おめ、なんでそんなテンション高ェーんだよプリィーン」
lines.english: “Shut up. Why are you so goddamn excited, Pretty Pudding?”

lines.japanese: 「ああああい！　アニキ痛い痛い！　イッちゃうイッちゃう、安男イッちゃう！　ヘヴンズドア開いちゃう！」
lines.english: “Aaaah! Big Bro, that hurts! I’m coming, I’m coming! Yasuo’s going to come! Heaven’s door is opening!”

lines.japanese: タチ悪りいなこいつ。俺の攻撃、無効化されんのかよ。
lines.english: This guy was impossible. Did my attacks actually heal him?

lines.japanese: 「ふぅ……んーだよアニキ、冷てえなあ。お連れさんに挨拶くらいしたっていーだろォ。将来、俺の姐さんになるかもしれないひとでしょォ～？　ハァーイ、よろしくプリティフェイス！」
lines.english: “Phew... What’s your problem, Big Bro? You’re so cold. I’m allowed to introduce myself to your companion, aren’t I? She might be my future big sister, riiight? Hiii, Pretty Face!”

lines.japanese: 「ど、どど、どもですた」
lines.english: “N-n-nice to met you.”

lines.japanese: 「いいから。相手しなくていいから」
lines.english: “It’s fine. Just ignore him.”

lines.japanese: 「出会った記念に、咲夜一発ロックします！」
lines.english: “To commemorate this meeting, Sakuya will now rock you with a number!”

lines.japanese: 「ワンツッスッホ！　ロリロリローリーロンリーローリー！　すかしたアイツはその実ロリータ、夜道を幼女と連れあるく！　世界の三大ロリ賢人！　キャロル、ナボコフ、八木隼人！　キャロル、ナボコフ、八木はや」
lines.english: “One, two, three, four! Loli, loli, lonely loli! That aloof fellow is secretly Lolita; he walks the nighttime streets with little girls! The world’s three great Lolita sages: Carroll, Nabokov, Hayato Yagi! Carroll, Nabokov, Hayato Ya—”

lines.japanese: 「とたたたた！　痛い痛い痛い、やめてアニキ、昇っちゃう昇っちゃう昇りつめちゃう、ここじゃ嫌～ッ！」
lines.english: “Ow ow ow ow! That hurts, Big Bro! Stop, I’m ascending, I’m reaching the summit! Not out here!”

lines.japanese: 「で。なんでおまえがこんなトコいんの」
lines.english: “So. Why the hell are you here?”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃ俺とあんたの仲だし？　隼人君的な電波がビシシつって、俺の脳天にバリンときちゃったってわけよイェイ、ロッキュー」
lines.english: “Well, you and me have that special bond, right? A Hayato signal went *bzzt*, cracked me on the crown, and brought me running. Yeah! Rock you!”

lines.japanese: 「おまえソレ本気で言ってんなら、いまここで二度と電波届かないよう脳天唐竹割っちゃうけど」
lines.english: “If you seriously believe that, I'll split your skull straight down the middle so no signal ever reaches you again.”

lines.japanese: 「ウソウソ！　俺ン家この辺なの。え、隼人君ちもこの辺？」
lines.english: “Kidding, kidding! I live around here. Wait, do you live nearby too?”

lines.japanese: 「いや全然」
lines.english: “Nowhere close.”

lines.japanese: 俺は嘘をついた。
lines.english: I lied.

lines.japanese: 「はるか彼方です」
lines.english: “A long, long way away.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩も追随した。
lines.english: Kobato followed my lead.

lines.japanese: 「ぬゎ～んだ残念。ご近所だったら容易にパジャマパーティーとか出来たのにねェ～ん」
lines.english: “Awww, too bad. If we were neighbors, we could throw pajama parties whenever we wanted.”

lines.japanese: 「遠い。すげー遠い」
lines.english: “Far away. Extremely far.”

lines.japanese: 「陸の孤島です」
lines.english: “Practically cut off from civilization.”

lines.japanese: 「そっかあ、それじゃ仕方ない──」
lines.english: “I see. Then I guess it can't be helped—”

lines.japanese: 「──アそーそー！　そんでさァ！　こないだアニキに、うちの隠しページ教えたッたけどさァ、うひへへへ、ゴメ～ンあそこもうすぐ捨てるわァ」
lines.english: “—Oh, right! And another thing! I showed you our hidden page the other day, Big Bro, but, uh-heh-heh, sorry—we're ditching it soon.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、ああ、へー、そーなん」
lines.english: “Huh. Oh. Wow. Is that right.”

lines.japanese: 俺が面倒くさげに相槌を打つと、佐久間はうんざりした表情で頷いた。
lines.english: When I gave him that weary little acknowledgment, Sakuma nodded, looking thoroughly fed up.

lines.japanese: 「そーりゃそーだよォ！　だってもうあそこ、グっズグズだもん！」
lines.english: “Of course! That place has gone completely to shit!”

lines.japanese: 「大司教は空気読めねーで荒し紛いンなっちゃうわ？　どこで聞きつけたんだかニワトリ連中が覗きに来やがるわ？　も、ファック！　ウザくてしょーがねンだよ死ねコラァァアあばばばばぁぁあ゛あぁあぁああ！」
lines.english: “The Archbishop can’t read a room and has practically turned into a troll! Somehow the Chicken crew found out and started peeking in! Fuck! It’s so damn annoying! Die, you bastaaards—ababababaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 「ま、そんなワケよ。そんなワケで俺ら、あのサイトはもう捨てちゃっててェ、うん、すでにＳＮＳ中心に移行してっからァ、だからアニキも今度からはそっちに来てよ」
lines.english: “So yeah, that’s the deal. We’ve already ditched that site. We mostly use social-networking sites now, so you should come join us there from now on, Big Bro.”

lines.japanese: やつが何を言ってるのかさっぱり分からない。俺は適当にへーへー頷いてた。
lines.english: I had no idea what he was talking about. I nodded along and made a few vague noises.

lines.japanese: 「っと、そだ、大司教ってばさァ」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Speaking of the Archbishop...”

lines.japanese: 「俺が言うのもなんだけど、隼人君、あんた気を付けてな。あのひと、ニワトリだけじゃなくて、あんたのこともかーなーり、恨んでるみたいだから」
lines.english: “I know I’m one to talk, but be careful, Hayato. That guy seems to hold a pretty serious grudge against you too—not just Chicken.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: なんだそりゃ。俺は耳を疑った。
lines.english: What was that supposed to mean? I could hardly believe my ears.

lines.japanese: 小鳩には聞こえないよう、佐久間を引きよせて声のボリュームを落とす。
lines.english: I pulled Sakuma closer and lowered my voice so Kobato couldn't hear.

lines.japanese: 「ふざけんなよ、意味分かんねえって。あいつやったの、俺じゃなくてニワトリじゃん」
lines.english: “Don't screw with me. That makes no sense. Chicken was the one who took him down, not me.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、そりゃそうだけど、でもあんとき──ほら、大司教がニワトリ撃とうとしたとき──あんた横から割って入って、ニワトリ助けちゃったじゃん」
lines.english: “Sure, that’s true. But back then—when the Archbishop tried to shoot Chicken—you jumped in from the side and saved him, remember?”

lines.japanese: 「ちゃったじゃん、って。おいおいおい。なんだよ、なんだよソレ。あんな場面に居合わせたら誰だって止めんだろフツー。なあ。そんなん逆恨みじゃねーか」
lines.english: “‘Saved him,’ you say. Come on. What the hell is that? Anybody who walked in on a scene like that would stop it. Anybody normal. He’s blaming me for his own shit.”

lines.japanese: 「んー、ともかく大司教って、そういう思考回路のひとだからさァ。ホント、気ぃ付けてよ？　あのひと、いま超テンパってて、何すっか分かんねー精神状態っつーか、ぶっちゃけもう頭イカれてっから」
lines.english: “Mm, anyway, that’s just how the Archbishop’s brain works. Seriously, watch out, okay? He’s freaking out so bad right now there’s no telling what he’ll do. Honestly, the guy’s gone completely nuts.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、それは……知ってッけど……」
lines.english: “Yeah, I... know that...”

lines.japanese: 俺は口をつぐんだ。かすかに胃が重かった。見えないところで自分への憎悪が育まれているという考えは面白くなかった。
lines.english: I fell silent. A faint weight settled in my stomach. There was nothing pleasant about imagining somebody’s hatred for me growing unseen.

lines.japanese: 「……なあ。あいつ、いま逃げまわってんだろ。どこにいるか、おまえら掴んでないの」
lines.english: “...Hey. He's on the run now, right? You people don't know where he is?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、掴んでねンだよ、悪りい。でも、そう遠くへは行ってねえと思うんだよ。案外いまも、すぐその辺に隠れてたりしてなァ」
lines.english: “No. Sorry, we don't. But I doubt he's gone far. Hell, he might be hiding somewhere right around here even now.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、でも、あいつ目立つから。メチャクチャその、頭といい服といいさ。だから、こっそり闇討ちとかは出来ないよね、その点は安心だ、はは」
lines.english: “Still, the guy stands out like crazy. The hair, the clothes, all of it. So he can’t exactly sneak up and jump you. At least that’s one thing you can take comfort in. Ha.”
“...You think?”

lines.japanese: いや、そんなわけはない。
lines.english: No. That wasn't true at all.

lines.japanese: 髪と服が目立つ？　だったら髪は切ればいい、服は着替えればいい。ついでにあのキモい化粧を落とせば完璧だ。
lines.english: His hair and clothes stood out? Then he could cut his hair and change his clothes. Wash off that disgusting makeup while he was at it, and the transformation would be complete.

lines.japanese: そうすれば、むしろ前の姿が強烈な印象として焼きついてる分、地味に群衆へ紛れるだけでそれ以上ない変装となるじゃないか。
lines.english: His old appearance had burned itself so vividly into people's minds that merely dressing plainly and blending into a crowd would make the perfect disguise.

lines.japanese: “案外その辺に隠れてたりしてなァ”
lines.english: *For all we know, he's hiding somewhere right around here.*

lines.japanese: やつの戯れ言が妙に残った。
lines.english: For some reason, his idle remark stuck with me.

lines.japanese: 「分かった、まあ適当に気をつけるわ」
lines.english: “Fine. I'll watch my back or whatever.”

lines.japanese: とりあえず忠告を受けとって佐久間と別れた。
lines.english: I took the warning for what it was, then parted ways with Sakuma.

lines.japanese: 俺が狙われている──
lines.english: I was being hunted—

lines.japanese: ──香田から佐久間から、立て続けに言われて危機感が現実味を帯びてきた。いちおう警戒の必要があるのかもしれない。
lines.english: —and hearing it in quick succession from Koda and Sakuma made the danger begin to feel real. Perhaps I did need to stay on my guard.

lines.japanese: しかし……俺には忠告があったけれど、あいつ、鳳翔はこのことを知っているのだろうか。
lines.english: But... I had been warned. Did Kakeru Otori know any of this?

lines.japanese: 仕方ない。面倒だが教えといてやるか。勝手にくたばられても気分が悪い。
lines.english: Fine. It was a nuisance, but I ought to tell him. I’d feel lousy if he went and got himself killed.

lines.japanese: しかしそう考えた次の瞬間、さっそく問題にぶち当たった。
lines.english: The instant I reached that conclusion, however, I ran into a problem.

lines.japanese: こちらから鳳翔に接触を図るにはどうすればいい？　当然だが、俺はやつの住所も電話番号もメールアドレスも何ひとつ知らない。
lines.english: How was I supposed to contact Kakeru Otori? Naturally, I didn't know his address, his phone number, or his email address. Nothing.

lines.japanese: じゃあ……森里やハゲたちに聞いてみるか。
lines.english: Then... should I ask Morisato or the bald guys?

lines.japanese: 連中がまださっきの場所でダベってるとは限らないが、行くだけ行ってみよう。何もしないのは胃がすっきりしない。俺は首に手を当て、こきりこきりと軽く鳴らした。
lines.english: They might not still be standing where I'd left them, but I could at least go and look. Doing nothing would leave my stomach unsettled. I put a hand to my neck and cracked it lightly from side to side.
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 急に黙りこんだ俺を、小鳩が探るような目で見詰めていた。
lines.english: Kobato was studying me after my sudden silence.

lines.japanese: 「ああ悪りい。おし、うるさいのもいなくなったし、さっさと帰ろう」
lines.english: “Oh, sorry. All right, now that the loudmouth's gone, let's hurry home.”

lines.japanese: 帰ってからまたすぐ出かけることになるが、ややこしくなるだけなのでそれは伏せておいた。
lines.english: I would be heading straight out again once we got home, but explaining that would only complicate matters, so I kept quiet.

lines.japanese: 「……なにか危ないことをしてるんでしょうか」
lines.english: “...Are you involved in something dangerous?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 小鳩がコンビニ袋を胸に抱きながら、ぼそぼそと声を出した。
lines.english: Kobato hugged the convenience-store bag to her chest and spoke in a mumble.

lines.japanese: 「危ないことはやめてください」
lines.english: “Please don't do anything dangerous.”

lines.japanese: 弱々しいが、しかしどこか責めるような声だった。
lines.english: Her voice was weak, but it carried a faint note of reproach.

lines.japanese: あなただけの体じゃないんですから、ってやつか。へーへー、おっしゃる通りです。
lines.english: *It's not just your own body you have to think of,* and all that. Yeah, yeah. I couldn't agree more.

lines.japanese: 俺は黙ってうなずき、ほとんど会話もないまま羽田の家まで並んで歩いた。
lines.english: I nodded without a word, and we walked side by side to the Haneda house with hardly any conversation.

lines.japanese: やつが寝つくまで待つつもりだったが、やはり何もせずじっとしているのはもどかしかった。
lines.english: I'd meant to wait until she fell asleep, but sitting still and doing nothing was too frustrating after all.

lines.japanese: 俺は仕事を思いだしたと言って飛びだし、来た道を引きかえした。冬の乾いた空気は、やっぱり喉の奥を刺してくる。
lines.english: I said I'd remembered some work, hurried outside, and retraced the road I'd come. The dry winter air still stabbed at the back of my throat.
